item.title: 'Dreams in Nightmares' is a road-trip movie about living on your own terms
item.description: Three queer Black friends embark on a road trip in search of a fourth whom they haven't seen in some time. Dreams in Nightmares is a sweetly bickersome comedy-drama about friendship and freedom.
item.content:encoded: Three queer Black friends embark on a road trip in search of a fourth whom they haven't seen in some time. Dreams in Nightmares is a sweetly bickersome comedy-drama about friendship and freedom.

item.title: Beatty files emergency request to stop Trump's name from returning to Kennedy Center
item.description: Joyce Beatty, a Democratic representative from Ohio, asked a federal judge to stop the Kennedy Center trustees from putting President Trump's name up in three places at the arts complex.

item.title: 'The Dog Stars' novelist Peter Heller drew on real-life survival skills
item.description: Heller's 2012 novel about a man who survives a super flu that kills most of humanity is now being adapted to film. Adventure writer Heller drew from his own life. Originally broadcast in 2012.

item.title: Harvard's American Repertory Theater puts on revival of Ionesco's 'Rhinoceros'
item.description: The American Repertory Theater at Harvard University premiers a revival of Eugène Ionesco's landmark play, "Rhinoceros." NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer talks to director Diane Paulus and actor John Turturro.

item.title: As the Tupac murder trial continues, a look back at the cultural moment
item.description: NPR's Juana Summers speaks with Joel Anderson, a host of the podcast Slow Burn, about the Tupac Shakur murder trial and the cultural moment around his murder.

item.title: Yahya Abdul-Mateen II has a theory about Marvel's 'Wonder Man' cancellation
item.description: Two weeks after being nominated for an Emmy for his leading role in Wonder Man, Abdul-Mateen found out that the series had been cancelled. He says Marvel could do more to support Black-led projects.

item.title: D.C.'s IndyCar race will zoom past museums. Some worry it could harm the art inside
item.description: Sunday's course takes high-speed cars right past the National Gallery of Art and three Smithsonian museums. Art experts worry about the works inside, but organizers say they don't expect damage.

item.title: Which country makes the best jollof rice? D.C. foodies put it to a blind test
item.description: One of the most famous dishes across West Africa is jollof rice — fragrant rice cooked down with spices, tomatoes and meat. But which version is best? A traveling festival aims to find out.
